summary: Local MVP cue trainer complete: Vite/React/TS app with fullscreen go/no-go drill, randomized cue + delay, keyboard (Space) input, per-rep reaction-time measurement, immediate feedback, session summary, and IndexedDB persistence via Dexie. Drill engine is a pure module with 16 unit tests; Zustand store has 8 orchestration tests; cue library has a smoke test (28 tests total, all green). Lint, tsc, and production build all pass. Pre-commit verify gate is wired (scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs npm lint + typecheck + tests under app/). Browser-verified by qa-playwright against all 7 acceptance criteria from docs/PHASES.md plus the mid-drill-reload persistence path. Code-reviewer round 1 raised 3 blockers (stale session row on tab close, untested pre-cue press path, duplicated rep-build logic); all 3 fixed and re-QA'd.

qa-playwright pressed Space; window-level keydown listener in TrainerScreen.tsx:19-36

qa-playwright observed colored feedback screens (GO ✓, HOLD ✓, LATE, FALSE START, HESITATION)

gates.dry: Rep-record construction unified in commitRep helper (session.ts); session summary derived from reps in one place (engine summarize).

B3: commitRep helper extracted; recordPress and finishWindow both delegate to it
